description: Send a Slack message using your stored Slack OAuth connection. No API key required — uses the token from your connected Slack account in ZeroDB.

channel.description: Slack channel name (e.g. "#general") or channel ID

message.description: Message text. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting.

thread_ts.description: Optional. Thread timestamp to reply in an existing thread.

name: zerodb_slack_send
